exposure: birth history (prenatal factors, perinatal factors, post-natal factors)
outcome: different types of cerebral palsy (e.g., spastic type)
cohort: The study included 120 children with a mean age of 3.6 years (SD 1.7) who were clinically diagnosed with cerebral palsy.
finding: Major risk factors showed a significant association with cerebral palsy, and regular prenatal checkups were found to have a great impact on reducing the ratio of risk factors in CP.
mod_finding: Within the cohort of children with cerebral palsy, 56 (46.6%) were delivered through C-Section and 64 (53.3%) were delivered by SVD, though no explicit association with CP or its types was stated.
